decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

It is considered that the modified roof design of the proposed single storey rear extension, by way of its position, design and appearance, has due regard for the sites characteristics and the visual aesthetics of the locality, and will not be detrimental to the amenity of the adjoining properties or surrounding environment.  The development is in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) H.4.1 (Housing standards and Guidelines) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; and is compliant with Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
